Guided by textual "gradients" from a 4-module propose-execute-select-update loop, ToolGrad reaches a 99.8% pass rate on ToolBench versus 63.8% for DFS search. Gemma-3-12B fine-tuned on only 500 samples scores 83.1 on BFCL, next to Gemini 2.5 Pro at 83.2. Code, dataset, and models are public under Apache-2.0.
